name: One Maritime Plaza Park
note: BUGS.md #180: the lawn with sculptures on the podium roof west of the One Maritime Plaza tower (way/28240176 — `embarcadero-maritime-aerial.png`), previously missing entirely. Placed by measuring way/28240176's own centroid/extent from the Overpass cache and offsetting west by its own half-width plus this court's half-width plus a small gap — not typed by eye. This is a FIFTH unit on its own footprint (a single tower over a garage), not one of the four `gapQuad` units, per the file header. The other half of #180 — the small brick building rendered sunken into the plaza — is a height-datum problem in whatever places that building on the ground instead of the deck; no such building is built by this file, so it is reported, not fixed here.
